Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction.

Subject: a single standalone solid rounded-rectangle plastic lid, seen slightly from above, matching the lid in the source exactly: broad smooth pastel peach-orange top, rounded corners, gentle pale edge highlight and a very shallow darker orange front lip. Color: smooth peach orange upper face (#FFCC8D) with a slightly stronger orange edge (#FFAF62), matching the orange bucket family.
Composition: show the complete lid floating alone on transparency, centered with even empty transparent margin around all four sides. No thick walls below the cap; all pixels where the bucket body used to be must be transparent.
Background: true alpha transparency. No bucket body, no container, no open cavity, no floor, no shadow, no pedestal, no support object.
Text: none.
Preserve: the top lid's rounded-rectangular shape, view angle, palette, and simple mobile game shading. Remove every other part of the source.

Style: same simple smooth mobile-game shading as input 1. No knob, latch, clasp, handle, decorations, text, digit, number, logo or watermark.
Background: true transparent alpha zero, clean antialiased contour. No floor, ground, cast shadow, glow, particles, other objects or extra lids.
